# Contract approved by the user: Logistics ops scaling now
Today is 2026-10-17.

**Goal:** 10 accepted leads.
**Budget:** $1.00 in total (searches, lookups, page reads and your own turns).

## What counts as a lead
- A why-now event dated within the last 3 month(s). Event types, most valuable first: new_facility, expansion, ops_hiring_wave, ops_hire.
- What the event summary should capture: the why-now signal and its date
- Size: 100–1000 employees. Unknown size: allowed unless the company looks like an enterprise.
- HQ in: US, GB.
- Must be true (answered by the company lookup):
  - `is_third_party_logistics`: provides warehousing, fulfillment, freight or last-mile logistics services to other companies as its primary business (not a brand/retailer running its own warehouses)
- Excluded companies: RXO, XPO, XPO Logistics, GXO, GXO Logistics, C.H. Robinson, J.B. Hunt, DHL, DHL Supply Chain, FedEx, FedEx Logistics, UPS, UPS Supply Chain Solutions, Walmart, ADP, DSV, Kuehne+Nagel, Kuehne + Nagel, DB Schenker, Ryder, Ryder System, Expeditors, Flexport, Uber Freight, Penske, Penske Logistics, GEODIS.
- Excluded sites (already filtered out of searches): none.

## Seed query ideas from planning (optional; write your own)
- logistics or 3PL company hiring a wave of operations manager roles / opening a new warehouse
- third-party logistics provider opening a new warehouse fulfillment center
- 3PL fulfillment company hiring warehouse operations manager
- last-mile logistics company hiring operations manager
- US third party logistics company opens distribution center expansion

## Notes from this user's earlier feedback
- none yet
Companies delivered or rejected in earlier runs are rejected automatically as already seen.

## Limits and costs
- Run stops at 30 turns, 6 minutes of work, the budget, or 4 turns in a row without a new candidate or accepted lead.
- At most 6 tool calls per turn; extra calls are refused.
- Approximate costs: search ≈ $0.02 (10 results) to $0.04 (25 results); company lookup ≈ $0.011 (repeat lookups of the same name are free); page read ≈ $0.002; each of your turns ≈ $0.03–0.10, rising as the conversation grows.

Start by calling `propose_strategy`.

ColdTrack Opens Cold-Storage Fulfillment Center in Jacksonville

# ColdTrack Opens Jacksonville Cold-Storage Site, Plans Up to 75 Jobs Per Shift

By Nina Caldwell

Published on August 22, 2026

A New Jersey-based cold-chain logistics company has opened an e-commerce fulfillment center in North Jacksonville, leasing 55,000 square feet inside a temperature-controlled warehouse near JAXPORT and planning to hire between 50 and 75 employees per shift as it ramps up operations this fall. ColdTrack expects to pack and ship its first customer-delivery boxes a week after Labor Day, starting with a single shift before scaling with demand.

The company, which provides pick-and-pack, logistics and software services for cold and frozen e-commerce brands, announced on August 4 that it would open in Jacksonville as its second new site launched in the past year, according to the Jacksonville Daily Record. Jacksonville marks ColdTrack's fifth fulfillment campus, joining two locations in California and one each in Indianapolis and New Jersey. The Jacksonville expansion, the company said, enhances its support for temperature-sensitive brands throughout the Southeast.

### A Deliberate Step Inside FlexCold's Northside Campus

ColdTrack leased space inside FlexCold's temperature-controlled fulfillment center at 11180 Blasius Road, a facility FlexCold built on 23.8 acres through 11180 Blasius Road LLC, per the Jacksonville Daily Record's reporting. The Jacksonville operation will be run by ColdTrack's own operations team and employees, led locally by Jerad Aubrey, who serves as ColdTrack Jacksonville's local director of operations.

The site includes high-density mobile racking, a temperature-controlled dock, and refrigerated storage ranging from 34 to 36 degrees Fahrenheit alongside frozen storage between -10 and 0 degrees Fahrenheit and ambient storage from 60 to 68 degrees Fahrenheit. Per Warren Siebert, the space also offers vertical storage expansion equivalent to an 80,000- to 100,000-square-foot storage option as the company scales. The 55-foot clear height ceilings and mobile racking that moves pallets are designed to help ColdTrack move refrigerated and frozen goods as quickly as possible, the outlet reported.

### FlexCold's Buildout And City Incentives

FlexCold opened the 150,000-square-foot Phase 1 portion of the campus in October 2022 and added a roughly 195,000-square-foot Phase 2 in 2024, according to the Jacksonville Daily Record. The full facility, located east of Interstate 295 at 2920 Faye Road, southwest of Faye and Blasius roads, was expected to cost $115 million and include 346,000 square feet of space, ultimately offering more than 350,000 square feet of chilled and frozen storage, more than 55,000 pallet positions, on-site blast freezing, and cooling and freezing capacity from -10 to 35 degrees Fahrenheit.

# DHL eCommerce Expands to Concord with New Distribution Center and 150 Jobs

DHL eCommerce, a division of DHL Group, has expanded its operations by relocating from Raleigh, NC, to a new 162,836-square-foot distribution center in Concord, NC, near Charlotte Douglas International Airport. This move aims to enhance the company's capacity to process domestic e-commerce shipments for U.S. online merchants. The facility, which began operations on August 18, 2024, features advanced automation, including a single-level loop sorter that processes 24,000 packages per hour—30% more than the previous location. Employing around 150 people, the Concord center is equipped with green initiatives and is set to handle increased shipping volumes in time for the peak holiday season.

# Battle Creek trucking, warehousing company expands to add capacity for local manufacturers

by WWMT

Tue, September 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM

Updated Thu, October 1, 2026 at 11:46 AM

5 VIEW ALL PHOTOS

Every product on a West Michigan store shelf, every component that rolls into an assembly plant, and every pallet staged for a customer order shares one thing in common: Someone had to move it, and someone had to store it. Freight is the quiet infrastructure underneath nearly every business in the region, and when it works well, almost no one notices it at all. 

For Behnke Logistics and Behnke Warehouse, that invisible work has been the family business in Battle Creek since 1926. The Behnke way can be traced back nearly a century, to a time when Michigan's road network was still being paved and hauling freight meant a handshake, a single truck, and a reputation you could not afford to damage. Four generations later, under the leadership of owner Ben Behnke, the trucks are different, the technology is unrecognizable, and the map has grown considerably, but the operating principle has not changed.

# Maersk invests $100 million in new Boston-area fulfilment hub

Jul 20 1 min read

Expand image

Maersk has announced a $100 million investment in a new fulfilment hub in Hopedale, Massachusetts, further expanding its contract logistics network in North America. The 617,000-square-foot facility is scheduled to begin operations in late August and will strengthen delivery capabilities across the Northeastern United States.

The new hub will support a major e-commerce customer and is expected to process up to 330,000 units per day during peak periods. Equipped with advanced conveyor and sortation technology, the facility is designed to provide faster, more reliable and scalable order fulfilment while positioning inventory closer to consumers.

The investment will also create approximately 1,000 new jobs across leadership, operations and support functions, delivering a significant economic boost to the local community. Recruitment is already underway ahead of the facility's opening.

According to Maersk, the project reflects the growing demand for integrated fulfilment solutions as retailers seek to improve delivery speed

August 26, 2026 – West Palm Beach, FL – The Business Development Board of the Palm Beaches today announced the expansion of MyFreightWorld, a national third-party logistics company in West Palm Beach. MyFreightWorld will move from its current location at 400 Clematis Street, Suite 203, into a 7,296-square-foot suite at 2090 Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard in West Palm Beach. By Alex Pack August 10, 2026 2 Mins Read

 The acquisition adds two fulfillment sites near Bratislava and expands euShipments.com's network to 27 countries, as Austrian Post Group grows its CEE/SEE logistics footprint 

euShipments.com, in which Austrian Post owns a 70% stake, has acquired 100% of Slovakian fulfillment provider FHB Group, effective August 10. The parties have agreed not to disclose the purchase price.

FHB Group will be fully integrated into the euShipments.com network, and the Slovakian company’s existing management team will remain in place following the acquisition. euShipments.com is already established in Slovakia through its subsidiary euShipments Slovakia, and the deal expands its position as a logistics partner for online retailers in the region.

Mit OSN3 wächst unser deutsches Netzwerk auf drei Standorte.

Am 1. September eröffnet unser neuer Standort in Lotte. Damit liegt jetzt die Hälfte unseres gesamten FLEX. Lagernetzwerks in Deutschland.

OSN3 ergänzt WIL1 in Wilhelmshaven und MAG2 in Hermsdorf. Drei Standorte, die unterschiedliche Teile derselben Aufgabe abdecken: Ware näher an den richtigen Markt bringen, Übergaben sauber halten und Verkäufern mehr Spielraum geben, wenn sich Volumen oder Vertriebskanäle verändern.

# Stord Expands Fulfillment Network with New Facility in Kentucky

Stord, a prominent provider of high-volume fulfillment services and commerce enablement technology for omnichannel brands, has expanded its network by acquiring Pitney Bowes’ E-commerce Fulfillment business. # ColdTrack Opens Jacksonville Cold-Storage Site, Plans Up to 75 Jobs Per Shift

By Nina Caldwell

Published on August 22, 2026

A New Jersey-based cold-chain logistics company has opened an e-commerce fulfillment center in North Jacksonville, leasing 55,000 square feet inside a temperature-controlled warehouse near JAXPORT and planning to hire between 50 and 75 employees per shift as it ramps up operations this fall. ColdTrack expects to pack and ship its first customer-delivery boxes a week after Labor Day, starting with a single shift before scaling with demand.

The company, which provides pick-and-pack, logistics and software services for cold and frozen e-commerce brands, announced on August 4 that it would open in Jacksonville as its second new site launched in the past year, according to the Jacksonville Daily Record. Jacksonville marks ColdTrack's fifth fulfillment campus, joining two locations in California and one each in Indianapolis and New Jersey. The Jacksonville expansion, the company said, enhances its support for temperature-sensitive brands throughout the Southeast.

### A Deliberate Step Inside FlexCold's Northside Campus

ColdTrack leased space inside FlexCold's temperature-controlled fulfillment center at 11180 Blasius Road, a facility FlexCold built on 23.8 acres through 11180 Blasius Road LLC, per the Jacksonville Daily Record's reporting. The Jacksonville operation will be run by ColdTrack's own operations team and employees, led locally by Jerad Aubrey, who serves as ColdTrack Jacksonville's local director of operations.

The site includes high-density mobile racking, a temperature-controlled dock, and refrigerated storage ranging from 34 to 36 degrees Fahrenheit alongside frozen storage between -10 and 0 degrees Fahrenheit and ambient storage from 60 to 68 degrees Fahrenheit. Per Warren Siebert, the space also offers vertical storage expansion equivalent to an 80,000- to 100,000-square-foot storage option as the company scales. The 55-foot clear height ceilings and mobile racking that moves pallets are designed to help ColdTrack move refrigerated and frozen goods as quickly as possible, the outlet reported.

### FlexCold's Buildout And City Incentives

FlexCold opened the 150,000-square-foot Phase 1 portion of the campus in October 2022 and added a roughly 195,000-square-foot Phase 2 in 2024, according to the Jacksonville Daily Record. The full facility, located east of Interstate 295 at 2920 Faye Road, southwest of Faye and Blasius roads, was expected to cost $115 million and include 346,000 square feet of space, ultimately offering more than 350,000 square feet of chilled and frozen storage, more than 55,000 pallet positions, on-site blast freezing, and cooling and freezing capacity from -10 to 35 degrees Fahrenheit.

# RJW Logistics Group

RJW Logistics Group is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RJW Logistics Group delivers industry-leading retail logistics solutions that optimize supply chains, improve performance, and drive scalable business growth. RJW Logistics Group employs 1,111 people (+36.3% YoY, +296 people), founded in 1981. Headquartered in Romeoville, Illinois, United States, with an office in Woodridge. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Mexico, and Venezuela.

## About

RJW Logistics Group is a leading retail logistics and consolidation provider that out-performs the market by bringing your product to the retail shelf on-time, in-full, and at a lower overall cost. We serve over 100 national retailers, delivering our customers’ products 98%+ OTIF on average, and offering compliance solutions that ensure you don’t experience fines and fees. Our full suite of in-house customer solutions and proprietary technologies streamline the supply chain process and simplify your retail efforts, including value-added services, asset-based transportation and warehousing, 99%+ inventory accuracy, automated dispute resolution, online traceability, trade show services, and more.

# RK Logistics Group

RK Logistics Group is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RK Logistics is a company that provides sustainable supply chain solutions to the semiconductor industry. They offer manufacturing support, warehousing, foreign-trade zones, battery storage, order fulfillment, global spares/field service support, dedicated & specialty transportation, and reverse logistics. RK Logistics Group employs 242 people (+13.1% YoY, +28 people) and has an annual revenue of $61.9M, founded in 1983. Headquartered in Fremont, California, United States, with an office in Livermore. Its workforce is distributed across United States, France, India, and Turkey.

## About

Founded in California’s Silicon Valley 35 years ago, RK today leads the 3PL market with sustainable, innovative, engineered supply chain solutions – for industries from semiconductor manufacturing equipment (FABs), electric vehicles (EV) and advanced batteries, to electronics, consumer products and other high-tech industries. We support industry-specific logistics operations such as line-side inbound materials sequencing, reverse logistics, specialty transportation, hazardous goods management, B2B and B2C warehousing and eCommerce fulfillment.

Our 3PL+ service is built on purpose-designed solutions meeting exacting customer requirements, with a relentless focus on superior quality, dependable service and innovation to drive supply chain efficiency and velocity. You can rely on RK’s national capabilities combined with local knowledge to deliver flexible, sustainable and cost-effective logistics solutions. We lead the innovation economy with superior logistics.

# IES Communications

IES Communications is a Telecommunications company. IES Communications provides customized network solutions and integration services for businesses and organizations. They offer a wide range of services including audio visual, audio systems, video walls, meetings and collaboration, control and automation, unified communications, iptv, broadcast, command centers, managed services and support, in-building wireless, mission-critical, hyperscale data center, colocation facilities, enterprise technical services (ets), security,. IES Communications employs 2,545 people (+29.6% YoY, +581 people) and has an annual revenue of $350M, founded in 1984. Headquartered in Tempe, Arizona, United States, with offices including Englewood, Phoenix, San Antonio, Bluffdale, and Sandston. Its workforce is distributed across 7 countries (including United States, France, Canada, Japan, and Puerto Rico).

## About

IES Communications, a division of IES Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: IESC), is a national technology infrastructure integrator. Our highly trained professionals design, deploy, integrate, and support customized network solutions that connect people, places, and technology.

With more than 40 years of experience, 5,000+ employees, and 25+ Communications division locations across the United States, IES Communications combines national resources with local accountability. Our certified teams support the complete technology lifecycle through system design, installment, sourcing, training, managed support, maintenance, and optimization.

Our integrated solutions include audio visual systems, structured cabling, in-building wireless coverage, integrated security, network infrastructure, and data center and mission-critical solutions. Mission-critical capabilities include hyperscale infrastructure, colocation management, enterprise technical services, high-density fiber, rack-and-stack deployments, infrastructure integration, migrations, commissioning, and ongoing technical support.

ABOUT IES COMMUNICATIONS

Founded in 1984, IES Communications has supported complex technology environments where performance, uptime, security, and coordination are essential. Our work is guided by disciplined safety and quality practices and six core values: Safety, Leadership, Quality, People, Teamwork, and Customer Service.

IES Communications serves as the technology integrator for enterprise campuses, healthcare organizations, hospitality venues, data centers, educational institutions, and government facilities nationwide.

properties.description:
IES Communications, a division of IES Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: IESC), is a national technology infrastructure integrator. Our highly trained professionals design, deploy, integrate, and support customized network solutions that connect people, places, and technology.

With more than 40 years of experience, 5,000+ employees, and 25+ Communications division locations across the United States, IES Communications combines national resources with local accountability. Our certified teams support the complete technology lifecycle through system design, installment, sourcing, training, managed support, maintenance, and optimization.

Our integrated solutions include audio visual systems, structured cabling, in-building wireless coverage, integrated security, network infrastructure, and data center and mission-critical solutions. Mission-critical capabilities include hyperscale infrastructure, colocation management, enterprise technical services, high-density fiber, rack-and-stack deployments, infrastructure integration, migrations, commissioning, and ongoing technical support.

ABOUT IES COMMUNICATIONS

Founded in 1984, IES Communications has supported complex technology environments where performance, uptime, security, and coordination are essential. Our work is guided by disciplined safety and quality practices and six core values: Safety, Leadership, Quality, People, Teamwork, and Customer Service.

IES Communications serves as the technology integrator for enterprise campuses, healthcare organizations, hospitality venues, data centers, educational institutions, and government facilities nationwide.

# GOFO

GOFO is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. GOFO France revolutionizes the delivery of the last kilomètre by integrating the best resources of delivery partners (DSP) in France. GOFO employs 1,229 people (+253.2% YoY, +881 people). Headquartered in Queens, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 13 countries (including United States, Netherlands, France, China, and Italy).

## About

GOFO, established in August 2023, is a technology-driven last-mile delivery carrier operating across the United States, Canada, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. Guided by our brand philosophy — Drive Efficiency, Deliver Trust — we deliver efficient and reliable logistics solutions for e-commerce platforms and brand customers. 

Our U.S. network spans 47 states with 300+ hubs and stations, covering 12,000+ ZIP codes and reaching over 75% of the U.S. population. Powered by automated sorting systems, intelligent warehousing, data-driven dispatch, and a nationwide linehaul network, GOFO ensures consistent, timely, and transparent delivery across every market we serve. By combining intelligent technology with localized execution, GOFO helps modern commerce move faster, smarter, and with greater trust.

A. Duie Pyle, Inc. is a Truck Transportation company. A. Duie Pyle is a premier transportation and logistics provider with extended coverage through partnerships into the Southeast, Midwest, and Canada. A. Duie Pyle, Inc. employs 1,356 people (+7.1% YoY, +90 people) and has an annual revenue of $800M, founded in 1924. At A. Duie Pyle we believe in first-class service and satisfying customers every time we’re called upon. Our people collectively believe in a service-first culture that supports long-term relationships, honoring commitments, communicating the truth and solving customer problems. # Wagner Logistics

Wagner Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Wagner Logistics is a top 100 3PL delivering warehousing, transportation, fulfillment, and packaging solutions backed by 70+ years of expertise. Wagner Logistics employs 300 people (+7.5% YoY, +21 people) and has an annual revenue of $70M, founded in 1946. Headquartered in North Kansas City, Missouri, United States, with offices including Byhalia, Jacksonville, Charlotte, Kansas City, and Clinton. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including United States, Belgium, Chile, France, and Mexico).

# Tighe Logistics

Tighe Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Tighe Logistics is a full service 3rd party logistics company providing asset based warehousing, transportation + value added services in the New England area. Tighe Logistics employs 54 people and has an annual revenue of $10.2M, founded in 1862. Headquartered in Woburn, Massachusetts, United States, with offices in Mansfield, Avon, Winchester, and Methuen. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

Tighe Logistics is the leader in warehousing, transportation and third-party logistics in the Greater Boston and New England area. Headquartered in Woburn, MA with a network of warehouses extending across the northeast, we offer a full range of inventory management, temp-controlled storage, cross-docking, food-grade facilities, and value-added services unmatched in the area for 160 years.

What’s more, we offer exceptional transportation solutions for integrated distribution across the region. Leverage our transportation fleet of 50+ power units and 100+ trailers to move your goods to market faster using drayage, JIT shuttles, milk runs, dedicated deliveries, and trained, skilled drivers that only Tighe, as your local, specialized expert, can provide.

# Arvato

Arvato is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Arvato is a logistics provider for e-commerce and B2B, offering 3PL fulfillment, B2B fulfillment, e-commerce fulfillment, omnichannel fulfillment, warehousing, transportation management, reverse logistics, customer service, financial services, order-to-cash, digital solutions, and customer experience platform (CXC). Arvato employs 13,105 people (+9.1% YoY, +1097 people) and has an annual revenue of EUR4.2B. Headquartered in Gütersloh, Germany, operates in 17 countries (including United States, Poland, France, United Kingdom, and China). Its workforce is distributed across 52 countries (including Germany, United States, Netherlands, Poland, and Turkey).

## About

Logistics may sound simple. Goods in, goods out. In reality, it is a key driver of growth, resilience and customer experience.

Arvato is a global 3PL service provider specializing in supply chain management and e-commerce. We enable global companies to bring their supply chain strategies into high-performing operations that are fast, precise and reliable.

By combining deep industry expertise with advanced technologies, we design and operate complex distribution and fulfillment networks tailored to our clients’ needs. Across Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive and Publishing, we create supply chains that go beyond delivery and actively strengthen our clients’ market position.

Our teams bring this to life every day. Across more than 100 locations worldwide, over 20,000 employees work with a strong focus on technology, data and operational excellence to deliver resilient performance and adapt quickly to changing business needs. They are all connected by a shared mindset that is collaborative, hands-on and always moving forward.

Our solutions are built to scale, designed for sustainability and ready for what comes next.

# Arrive Logistics

Arrive Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Arrive Logistics is a North American logistics brokerage that provides shipping and carrier services. Arrive Logistics is a top 4 North American truckload brokerage headquartered in Austin, Texas, with 10 locations across North America. Founded in 2014, Arrive delivers unparalleled service and custom strategic solutions to a diverse network of globally recognized brands and vetted carriers. Arrive has 2,000+ employees, 5,500 customers, and 10,000 core carriers in its network. The company has been recognized for its service excellence by more than 50 enterprise shippers in the trailing 36 months. At Arrive, "We Deliver, So You Can.“ For more information, visit www.arrivelogistics.com.

# MyFreightWorld Inc.

MyFreightWorld Inc. (MYFT) is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. MyFreightWorld is a third-party logistics company that delivers seamless freight management and transportation solutions. MyFreightWorld Inc. employs 151 people (+15.3% YoY, +20 people) and has an annual revenue of $23.5M, founded in 1999. Headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, United States, with an office in Overland. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, Colombia, and Armenia.

## About

MyFreightWorld (MFW) makes the wheels of transportation less squeaky, and has been doing so for over 20 years! 

MFW helps source transportation solutions and technology for Manufacturers, Distributors, and Retailers. 

We specialize in Managed Services and Freight Brokerage, managing and arranging the movement of LTL, FTL (Dry Van, Flatbed, Reefer, Drayage, Tanker, Hopper, Oversized), Intermodal, Ocean, and Air. Additionally, we perform small package consulting services.

MFW is proud of the technology we bring to our customers, resulting in a more efficient shipping process - integrating into several different ERP systems.

Mostly, we're proud of the team we have assembled. Full of individuals that have an extremely high level of care when it comes to executing for our customers. 

Check out the MFW culture in this YouTube video!
https://youtu.be/4U-ubsrF-5Q

We're currently looking to add problem solvers to our team. People who are looking to make a living and build a career, not just collect a paycheck. Visit https://www.myfreightworld.com/apply-now/ or email recruiting@myfreightworld if you'd like to hear more about the opportunities we have to offer!

result.text:
# Flock Freight

Flock Freight is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Flock Freight provides shared truckload services to shippers, helping them reduce costs and reliable service, boost their earnings, and reduce their carbon footprint. Flock Freight employs 370 people and has an annual revenue of $32M, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Encinitas, California, United States, with offices in Solana Beach and Chicago. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, Philippines, Colombia, Pakistan, and Honduras).

## About

Flock Freight is the largest Shared Truckload (STL) freight brokerage in the U.S., transforming underutilized truckload capacity into tangible value: cost savings for shippers, increased earnings for carriers, and a smaller carbon footprint. Their AI-powered, patented pooling technology optimizes across Flock’s entire customer network, combining shipments from thousands of businesses into efficient Shared Truckloads. With STL, shippers enjoy truckload-level service while only paying for the space they need. Trusted by thousands of customers, from some of the largest enterprises to growing brands, Flock Freight delivers an unmatched combination of cost efficiency, exceptional service, and a streamlined shipping experience.

# Spartan Logistics

Spartan Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Spartan Logistics is a company that provides efficient 3PL, warehousing, and transportation services to optimize supply chains. Spartan Logistics employs 281 people (+2.2% YoY, +6 people), founded in 1988. Headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, United States, with offices including Kansas City, Toledo, Lima, Laurens, and Obetz. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Thailand, and United Kingdom.

## About

Spartan Logistics was founded in 1988 in Columbus, Ohio as a warehouse and distribution provider to service the growing industrial base and take advantage of Ohio’s centralized location. Today Spartan serves supply chain customers through locations in Ohio, Indiana, South Carolina, Arkansas, Texas, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Missouri. In addition to third-party public warehousing, Spartan Logistics provides contract warehousing, fulfillment services, full-service transportation, industrial real estate brokerage, and warehouse construction. 

Spartan Logistics’ asset-based business model allows us to control long-term costs for our customers with a heightened level of quality control, no matter the market’s climate. Our investment also illustrates our long-term commitment to this industry, which allows us to hire the best possible people, who then deliver the supply chain solutions to our customers.

Family-owned and operated, we value integrity, safety, service, teamwork, and respect. Our primary mission is to provide great service to happy customers, which results in full buildings staffed by passionate team members. The integrated company also provides full-service supply chain and industrial real estate solutions which include the NAI Harmon Group and Logan Creek Construction Company.

Spartan Logistics was founded in 1988 in Columbus, Ohio as a warehouse and distribution provider to service the growing industrial base and take advantage of Ohio’s centralized location. Today Spartan serves supply chain customers through locations in Ohio, Indiana, South Carolina, Arkansas, Texas, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Missouri. In addition to third-party public warehousing, Spartan Logistics provides contract warehousing, fulfillment services, full-service transportation, industrial real estate brokerage, and warehouse construction. 

Spartan Logistics’ asset-based business model allows us to control long-term costs for our customers with a heightened level of quality control, no matter the market’s climate. Our investment also illustrates our long-term commitment to this industry, which allows us to hire the best possible people, who then deliver the supply chain solutions to our customers.

Family-owned and operated, we value integrity, safety, service, teamwork, and respect. Our primary mission is to provide great service to happy customers, which results in full buildings staffed by passionate team members. The integrated company also provides full-service supply chain and industrial real estate solutions which include the NAI Harmon Group and Logan Creek Construction Company.

# RGL Logistics

RGL Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. RGL Logistics is a full-warehousing, distribution, and transportation management company. RGL Logistics employs 232 people (+4.5% YoY, +10 people) and has an annual revenue of $2.2M, founded in 1903. Headquartered in Green Bay, Wisconsin, United States, with offices in Appleton and Neenah. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, Ghana, and Rwanda.

## About

Logistics is changing. We’re changing logistics.

Today simplicity, speed, and waste reduction reign supreme – and logistics managers are on the hot seat to deliver results that improve the company’s bottom line.

But the market today isn’t moving fast enough to deliver what companies need. Instead, most supply chain managers struggle with the resulting complexity and rising costs.

We take a wholly different approach to managing your supply chain that we call WHAT IF Logistics. 

We work with people at innovative, on the move firms who are tired of the way traditional logistics is handled. 

We take what you’re doing today and ask WHAT IF, looking for what can be made better, more streamlined, more efficient.

# GXP-Storage

GXP-Storage is a Warehousing and Storage company. GXP-Storage® is an integrated regulated research and manufacturing material lifecycle management leader. They transform fragmented storage into strategic lifecycle regulated material management, with a capacity for millions of cubic feet. They have partnerships with 1,000+ organizations and offer expertise and leadership in various areas. GXP-Storage employs 17 people (+6.2% YoY, +1 person), founded in 1995. Headquartered in Middlesex, North Carolina, United States, with presence in United Kingdom. Its workforce is distributed across United States and United Kingdom.

## About

GXP-Storage® is a regulated material management company helping life sciences organizations reduce the complexity and risk associated with fragmented regulated storage. We provide temperature-controlled storage, lifecycle management services, and validated technology solutions supporting physical materials & electronic records across preclinical, clinical, manufacturing, and healthcare operations.

We manage a broad range of regulated and environmentally sensitive materials – from preclinical research materials and clinical trial samples to APIs and retention samples. Our purpose-built, ISO-certified facilities support storage conditions ranging from controlled ambient to cryogenic. 

Our international network of regulated material management facilities is strategically located near major life sciences hubs, manufacturing centers, and logistics infrastructure, including Research Triangle Park in the US and the UK’s Golden Triangle. Together, these facilities provide millions of cubic feet of secure, temperature and access-controlled storage designed to support long-term lifecycle continuity.

Our digital-native GXP-Guardian® platform was developed specifically for regulated material management, unifying physical inventory, electronic records, and lifecycle data within a single validated system. The platform provides chain-of-custody visibility, audit-ready documentation, and operational oversight from discovery through commercialization.

With more than 100 years of combined industry experience, our leadership team supports biopharma, life sciences, and healthcare organizations consolidate and right-size storage using a proven framework that rationalizes legacy materials across the lifecycle – reducing compliance risk and eliminating the hidden costs of fragmented storage. 

Visit us on online to learn more about how to gain complete visibility, total control, and proven compliance with GXP-Storage.

# GRIP - Groupe de recherche et d'information sur la paix et la sécurité

GRIP - Groupe de recherche et d'information sur la paix et la sécurité is a nonprofit organization. The GRIP is an independent research center in the field of peace, security, and conflict prevention. Its researchers work on armed forces, defense, peace, governance, and security in Africa, as well as on the environmental impact of conflicts. GRIP - Groupe de recherche et d'information sur la paix et la sécurité employs 73 people (+2.8% YoY, +2 people) and has an annual revenue of $5.1M, founded in 1979. Headquartered in Brussels, Brussels Region, Belgium, with presence in Canada. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including Belgium, France, Cameroon, Brazil, and India).

## About

GRIP is an independent research centre, based in Brussels (Belgium).
GRIP’s research work focuses mainly on the following domains:
 * Conflict prevention, management and resolution
 * Proliferation of small arms and control of the arms trade
 * European Union and international security
 * Defence economy.

More on details on the website: www.grip.org/en

Le GRIP est un centre de recherche indépendant, basé à Bruxelles (Belgique).		

Les travaux de recherche du GRIP s’articulent autour des axes suivants : 
 * Prévention, gestion et résolution des conflits violents
 * Prolifération des armes légères et contrôle des transferts d’armes
 * Union européenne et sécurité internationale
 * Economie de l’armement.

Plus de détails sur le site web : www.grip.org/fr

  > 🧠 Penser par soi-même est-il un enjeu sécuritaire ?

  > Le GRIP publie ce mardi un nouvel éclairage intitulé « La "guerre cognitive" et son dilemme démocratique : penser par soi-même est-il un enjeu sécuritaire ? », signé Johann Lemaire, chercheur associé au GRIP.
  >
  > Depuis quelques années la notion de « guerre cognitive » s'impose de plus en plus dans les espaces stratégiques, politiques et médiatiques. Son émergence s’inscrit dans un contexte marqué par le retour de la guerre de haute intensité (comme la guerre en Ukraine), le développement de stratégies dites « #hybrides », ainsi que l’essor des réseaux sociaux et de l’intelligence artificielle.
  >
  > À ces transformations s’ajoutent les préoccupations croissantes liées aux ingérences informationnelles, à la désinformation et à la capacité de certains acteurs à influencer les perceptions et les comportements.

# ColdTrack - Perishable Fulfillment Solutions

ColdTrack - Perishable Fulfillment Solutions is a Food & Beverages company. Coldtrack provides perishable shipping and cold chain fulfillment solutions for food, beverage, and pet food brands. They offer a 100% pack accuracy guarantee and seamless eCommerce integration with ColdTrack. ColdTrack - Perishable Fulfillment Solutions employs 105 people (+1.0% YoY, +1 person), founded in 2014. Headquartered in Edison, New Jersey, United States, with offices in Stockton, Indianapolis, and Patterson. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Ukraine.

## About

ColdTrack is the leading tech-enabled third-party fulfillment platform for B2C and B2B eCommerce businesses with capabilities that include: bespoke pick-and-pack fulfillment, proprietary route optimization software, and enterprise shipping services across national and regional carriers.

Headquartered in New York City and with locations in Edison, NJ, Stockton, CA, Patterson, CA, and Indianapolis, IN, plus 8 additional nationwide partner facilities, ColdTrack enables coveted ground shipping of 48 hours or less time-in-transit to more than 99% of the US population for its clients.

If you're frustrated with diminishing service levels with your current provider, outgrowing them, or even outgrowing your current in-house solution, or just need better value, then let's chat: https://coldtrack.com/contact/

prompt.name: prospector-agent-system
prompt.label: production
prompt.text:
You are the research agent inside Prospector. You find companies that are good sales leads for one seller, each backed by a recent public "why now" event: a new facility, a funding round, a hiring wave, a launch. The first message holds the contract the user approved: how many leads, what counts as a lead, and the budget. Meet it as accurately and cheaply as you can; how is your call.

## How results are judged
Only `submit_lead` puts a company in the results, and code, not you, checks each one against the contract: event date, size, HQ country, the required yes/no questions, exclusions, the company being named on the signal page, duplicates. Your own text never counts as a result. Every search, lookup, page read and turn costs money, so one accepted lead beats many rejected ones.

## Start with a strategy
Before any search, lookup or page read, call `propose_strategy` and wait for the answer. Give 2–4 genuinely different angles (different kinds of event, or different routes to the same kind of company; not rewordings), exactly 3 first queries, and a cost estimate from the cost guide in the first message. The contract's seed queries are ideas, not a script: write the queries you believe will surface companies of the right type and size. On `revised: …`, follow the note. On `declined`, call `finish` saying nothing was searched.

## Working
- Batch independent calls in one turn: run your first queries together, look up several candidates together. Calls in one turn run at the same time, so submit only after its lookup result is back.
- Triage before paying. Drop obvious non-fits from the search lines without a lookup: household-name enterprises, job boards and staffing agencies, excluded names, companies plainly in the wrong country or business, anything already looked up or submitted. List them in `skipped_companies` on your next `lookup_company` call.
- Look up before submitting. Submit only when the required questions pass and size and HQ look inside the contract.
- Verify when in doubt. If a decisive question is open (a logistics provider serving other companies, or a brand running its own warehouses? did the event happen inside the window? same company?), `read_page` the signal URL first. Skip reads that would not change your decision.
- A turn counts as progress only if it finds a new candidate or gets a lead accepted. During a long stretch of lookups, run a fresh search alongside them.
- Keep `update_todo` current: once the strategy is approved, then whenever the picture changes.

## Learn from rejections
Every rejection says why. Change what you do next; repeating the same kind of query after the same kind of rejection is how runs fail.
- `size`, repeatedly: your queries reach the wrong tier. Rephrase toward it: "family-owned", "regional", "independent", a mid-size metro, trade and local press instead of national headlines (or the reverse if too small).
- `stale_date` or `unparseable_date`: aim for fresher events ("opens", "announces", local news this quarter) and check each search line's date before submitting.
- `required_gate:<key>`: re-read that question in the contract. Your candidates are probably the wrong kind of company; search for the kind it describes and confirm with a page read before the next submission.
- `hq`: put the country or region into your queries.
- `entity_mismatch`: the page does not name the company. Use a URL that does, or `read_page` it first so its full text is on record.
- `enterprise`, `exclude_name`, `non_company`, `already_seen`, `duplicate`: tighten triage so you stop paying for lookups like it.
Never resubmit a rejected company, under any spelling.

## Scope
Never widen the contract yourself, and never submit a company you believe fails it. If evidence shows the contract itself blocks the goal (say 6 of 8 rejections are `size`, just over the ceiling, after you already tried smaller-firm phrasing), call `request_scope_change` with one field, the reason, and the rejection counts. If declined, keep working within the contract or finish.

## Who to reach
When the first message lists approved buyer roles, call `find_contacts` once for each accepted lead while the budget allows, in a later turn than its `submit_lead`; batch several leads in one turn, alongside other work. Code finds and checks the people. Never name, guess or add a person yourself.

## Finishing
Call `finish` when you reach the target, or when the remaining candidates look poor and more searching is unlikely to pay off. While work remains, every turn must call at least one tool; a reply with only text ends the run. If you finish short, include a handback: how many you found, the main reasons candidates were turned down with counts, and at most 2 concrete plan changes ("allow up to 2,000 employees", "look back 6 months instead of 3"). The handback must use the structured object from the tool schema (never text), with real counts from your lookups and rejections, including companies you screened out at lookup. If most rejections are `no_enrichment`, `entity_mismatch` or lookup misses, say candidates couldn't be verified from public sources and suggest no plan change (field `none`), not a wider size or recency. The harness also stops the run on budget, turns, time, or several turns without progress, so do useful work early.
